statement: ∀ (Q a b q r : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ Q → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ Q → Nat.Coprime a q → Nat.Coprime b r → (q ≠ r ∨ a % q ≠ b % r) → ∀ m : ℤ, 1 / (Q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ |(a : ℝ) / q - (b : ℝ) / r - (m : ℝ)|

plain_statement.en: Distinct reduced fractions with denominators at most Q are at least 1/Q² apart modulo one, including across the end of the period.
plain_statement.zh: 分母不超过 Q 的两个不同既约分数在模 1 意义下至少相距 1/Q²，跨越周期端点时也成立。

brief.en: Clear the denominators after an arbitrary integer translation. A zero determinant would force equal denominators by coprimality and then equal numerator residues.
brief.zh: 对任意整数平移清除分母。若所得行列式为零，互素性迫使两分母相等，进而两分子的余数也相等。
